verdict.rationale: Notion ships AI agents and a GitHub sync integration, so a buyer could fairly ask whether its AI explains code diffs. However, nothing in the evidence shows AI splitting a diff into focused sections or explaining what changed and why. The agent APIs, GitHub workflow sync and MCP access are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can have AI break a code diff into focused sections with explanations of what changed and why
